# REVERSE ENGINEERING - CONHECIMENTO AVANÇADO

## FUNDAMENTOS

### Assembly Basics
**x86-64 Registers:**
- RAX, RBX, RCX, RDX (general purpose)
- RSI, RDI (source/destination index)
- RSP (stack pointer)
- RBP (base pointer)
- RIP (instruction pointer)

**Common Instructions:**
```asm
mov rax, rbx     ; Move
add rax, 5       ; Addition
sub rax, rbx     ; Subtraction
xor rax, rax     ; XOR (common zero)
push rax         ; Push to stack
pop rbx          ; Pop from stack
call func        ; Function call
ret              ; Return
```

**Calling Conventions:**
- Linux x64: RDI, RSI, RDX, RCX, R8, R9
- Windows x64: RCX, RDX, R8, R9
- Return: RAX

### Binary Formats
**ELF (Linux):**
- Header, Program Headers, Sections
- .text (code), .data (initialized), .bss (uninitialized)
- Dynamic linking, PLT/GOT

**PE (Windows):**
- DOS header, NT headers, sections
- .text, .data, .rdata, .idata (imports)
- IAT (Import Address Table)

## FERRAMENTAS

### Disassemblers
**IDA Pro:**
```
F5 - Decompile
G - Jump to address
X - Cross-references
N - Rename
```

**Ghidra:**
- Free, open-source
- Decompiler integrado
- Scripting (Python, Java)

**Binary Ninja:**
- Modern UI
- BNIL (Binary Ninja IL)
- Plugin API

### Debuggers
**GDB (Linux):**
```bash
gdb ./program
break main
run
step / next
print $rax
x/10gx $rsp  # Examine stack
```

**x64dbg (Windows):**
- Graph view
- Plugin system
- Script engine

**WinDbg:**
- Kernel debugging
- Time-travel debugging
- SOS extension (.NET)

### Hex Editors
- 010 Editor (templates)
- HxD
- ImHex

## ANÁLISE ESTÁTICA

### String Analysis
```bash
strings binary | grep -i "password"
rabin2 -z binary  # Radare2
```

### Import/Export Analysis
```bash
objdump -T binary  # Dynamic symbols
nm binary          # All symbols
ldd binary         # Dependencies
```

### Control Flow Analysis
- Identify functions
- Map call graph
- Detect recursion
- Find loops

### Data Flow Analysis
- Track variable usage
- Identify data structures
- Detect buffer operations
